title: They Fined My Garden. Their Own Map Canceled It.
script: My HOA sent me a $75 fine because my vegetable beds were supposedly in a shared green space. I checked the community map and noticed the green space ended exactly at my fence. The board president still told me to remove everything by Friday. Fine. I requested a formal hearing and brought the plat, my survey, and the same map attached to their violation notice. At the meeting, she insisted the rule was obvious until the property manager enlarged the boundary on the projector. My garden was private. Her decorative stone path, however, crossed three feet into the shared area. The manager asked whether enforcement should be consistent. I said absolutely. The board canceled my fine and gave her thirty days to move the path she had installed without approval. The next newsletter reminded everyone to verify property lines before filing complaints. My tomatoes remained dangerously stationary.
